description: This is a utility script for exporting the OpenAPI schema from a FastAPI application. It imports the FastAPI app from 'src.api.main' and provides functions to generate and save the OpenAPI specifications into a JSON file located in the 'interfaces' directory. The script is meant for generating interface contracts for the API, rather than implementing core API functionality.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] generate_openapi_dict()
methods.description: Generates and returns the OpenAPI schema dictionary from the FastAPI app.

methods.name: Path export_openapi_to_file(out_path: Path | None = None)
methods.description: Exports the OpenAPI schema to a JSON file at a specified path or default location.

methods.name: Path _resolve_interfaces_path()
methods.description: Resolves the output path for the OpenAPI JSON file relative to this script's location.

methods.name: int _main()
methods.description: CLI entry point that exports the OpenAPI schema to the default location and prints confirmation.
